title: fragaria × rosea
intro: Fragaria × rosea, commonly known as the Rosa Rugosa, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the rose family and is native to East Asia. It is known for its fragrant flowers, dark green leaves, and edible fruits, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria × rosea include its ability to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and aid in wound healing, all due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which work to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents present in Fragaria × rosea have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable plant for medicinal and therapeutic applications.
